messages:
sara: :rotating_light: paging oncall — elevated 5xx and timeouts hitting north-central edge gateways (nc1). multiple downstream 504s and connection resets seen in the last 3m. auto-failover partly triggered. tagging eng-sre and infra.

pagerduty: Automated page: sara is now on call for incidents in channel #incidents.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gateway-504s (read-only).

matt: on it. I see a spike in gateway 504s to mlworker upstream from nc1-proxy: `502/504` on health checks.

neha: are we seeing any error spikes from the serving runtime or worker OOMs?

matt: not OOMs. Logs show frequent `connect: connection reset by peer` from proxylb -> mlworker for about 2m. Example: 
```
2026-03-15T16:12:01Z proxylb nc1-03 -> mlworker-12 ERROR connect: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
2026-03-15T16:12:02Z proxylb nc1-03 upstream 504 "gateway timeout" route=/v1/generate
```

kai: I just checked edge route table changes at ~16:09 UTC — there was a config push to MTU and keepalive on the nc1 VPC router by infra-cfg bot. Could be related.

sara: matt + kai, prioritize: (1) confirm whether cfg push correlates, (2) wire traffic away if needed, (3) communicate customer impact. neha, can you collect top customer traces for last 10m?

neha: grabbing traces now. initial filter: ~2.3k requests in 10m got 5xx, top impacted tenants: org-clarity, org-lumen (about 40% of 5xx).

matt: running quick probe from control plane to mlworker pool in nc1: `curl -v http://mlworker-nc1.internal/health` -> returns `ssh: read: connection reset by peer` at TCP level. I can repro from control plane.

kai: I'm rolling back the MTU/keepalive change on the nc1 router to previous config now. Command: `infractl router rollback nc1 --rev 2026-03-15-0912`. I'll post when complete.

incident-bot: Deployment/rollback triggered by kai: infractl job #7432.

matt: after rollback, I'm seeing a drop in connection resets on probes. Health checks are flapping less. Still a residual 5xx tail.

neha: customer traces show many requests timing out around 3-4s before 504s, consistent with upstream TCP resets.

sara: start temporary mitigations: (A) steer traffic from nc1 to nc3 and nc-west pools for critical routes only, (B) enable prefix KV cache for high-volume routes to reduce worker pressure, (C) increase edge timeout to 20s as stopgap. matt/kai coordinate.

matt: doing a targeted route steer: `routectl steer --from nc1 --to nc3 --tag critical --percent 70` to move critical traffic. Also adding an ingress annotation to reduce keepalive churn: `proxy.k8s.io/keepalive: 60s` on nc1 proxies.

kai: traffic steering applied. Telemetry shows critical route from nc1 -> nc3 increased as expected. Noncritical still flows to nc1.

neha: after steer, 5xx for critical customers dropped ~85%. Noncritical still elevated for a small cohort due to some regional pools not draining fast.

sara: good. Create a short customer update: minimal wording, ETA for full mitigation. I'll send external note after you confirm stability for 15m.

matt: I'm watching tail logs for mlworker group. There's an odd pattern: certain workers (mlworker-12..15) show `tcp_abort` counters high; kernel logs show `net: tcp: retransmission timeout` before reset. Suspect NIC driver/kernel path and MTU mismatch with infra change.

kai: agree. Rolling a targeted cordon/drain of the affected worker hosts and forcing replacement: `k8s drain node mlworker-12 && k8s delete node mlworker-12` to pick new healthy host from autoscaler.

incident-bot: Node replacement jobs queued: autoscale requested 4 new nodes.

matt: draining complete for 12-15. New nodes joined, health checks passing for most. Aggregate 5xx rate now trending down to baseline for critical customers.

neha: capturing a concise impact summary for postmortem: timeline, customers impacted, root cause hypothesis (MTU/keepalive cfg + NIC/kernel interactions), mitigation steps (rollback, traffic steer, node replace), next steps.

sara: set severity to P1 if external customer-facing SLOs are affected — do metrics show SLO breaches?

neha: SLO window shows org-clarity and org-lumen breached 5m SLO at 16:10-16:18. That's P1 for those tenants. Not global P1. Recommend P1-Partial.

sara: okay marking as P1-Partial and opening incident bridge for postmortem. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/INC-2026-0315-01-bridge.

matt: log snippets for later: 
```
16:12:01 proxylb nc1-03 -> mlworker-12: connect reset (errno=104)
16:12:15 kernel[mlworker-12]: tcp: retransmission timeout, possible MTU blackhole
16:13:02 infra-cfg: pushed update router/nc1 mtu=9000 keepalive=15s rev=2026-03-15-0912
```

kai: I will open a ticket with infra-cfg team to add a canary check on router parameter changes and to block MTU changes during active traffic windows. Ticket: INFRA-4721.

neha: I'm drafting the customer-facing blurb: short, apologetic, describe mitigations and ETA. I'll route to comms for sign-off.

sara: nice. For handoff — matt, you'll continue triage for 1h and capture exact affected node IDs and kdump logs. kai, follow infra-cfg remediation and ensure the rollback is tested in staging. neha, finalize impact numbers and patch customer note. I'll do the incident postmortem doc.

matt: ack. I'll collect `tcpdump` and `dmesg` for the affected nodes and attach to the incident doc.

kai: ack, I'll follow up with infra-cfg leads and propose a safe change gating policy.

incident-bot: Update: INC-2026-0315-01 status -> mitigated. Duration so far: 36m.

sara: switching to monitoring/verification mode. If things stay stable for 45m, we'll close and schedule a full postmortem.

neha: final note for thread: total affected requests ~2.9k, peak 5xx rate 9.8% of nc1 traffic, critical tenants returned to baseline after steer.

sara: thanks team. I'll post an internal summary in #postmortems and link this thread. Please upload artifacts (logs, kdump, infra rollback diffs) into INC-2026-0315-01 doc.

matt: uploaded pcap + dmesg to the incident doc.

kai: INFRA-4721 created and linked.

neha: customer note ready and pushed to comms queue.

sara: handing off to matt for ongoing root cause; I’m off-call in 20m. Leave a short status update here before you step away.

matt: status: mitigation complete, triage in progress, continuing log collection for 2h, will update before 18:30 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01: next update target 2026-03-15T18:30:00Z.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup:
